Package com.bilt.pos.session

Class TransactionStatusResult

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.session.TransactionStatusResult
public final class TransactionStatusResult extends Object
Outcome of CheckoutSession.getTransactionStatus(String).

When the original transaction was found (isFound()), the terminal repeats the original response; exactly one of the typed response accessors is non-null, indicated by getMessageCategory().
